name: Exploding Statue

source.title: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

disable: DC 21 Thievery check (trained) to safely cut the wire

items.name: Explosion
items.text:
Trigger A creature opens the northern door without first disabling the trip wire

---

Effect The statue explodes, spraying shrapnel to the west in a 5-foot cone and dealing 1d10+7 piercing and 1d10 fire damage to all creatures in the affected area (DC 18 basic Reflex save save).

text: A hollow statue filled with explosives is connected to a trip wire running along the adjacent door.
